I'm not sure I understand your situation. Is it that you have a copy of your Thunderbird Profile but you don't know were to put it?

You don't mention what your operating system is, but the default location in Windows is "C:\Users\<your Windows login username>\AppData\Roaming\Thunderbird\Profiles\".

Here's an article about profiles, incuding how to restore a back-up copy of one:

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profiles-where-thunderbird-stores-user-data
